blocks.raw: We are super excited to announce the launch of our Mutual Funds and Fixed Income products. If you haven’t seen our press releases on these products, check out this link to [learn](https://lnkd.in/e_z5d6UU) more. With the launch of these products, you are able to introduce new investment strategies to your clients which will improve stickiness to your existing offering. We have truly focused on making the onboarding of customers’ of these products just as easy as our current equities solution. Interested in learning more about Mutual Funds or Fixed Income, please reach out to <partnersolutions@drivewealth.com> or your assigned account manager.

With the launch of these products, you are able to introduce new investment strategies to your clients which will improve stickiness to your existing offering. We have truly focused on making the onboarding of customers’ of these products just as easy as our current equities solution. Interested in learning more about Mutual Funds or Fixed Income, please reach out to partnersolutions@drivewealth.com or your assigned account manager.

blocks.raw: For Fixed Income, we have released two endpoints in this release: The filter endpoint (exclusive to Fixed Income) helps in screening the fixed-income instrument universe and supports a rich filtering criteria. After filtering, the instrument endpoint can then be used to get reference data for that instrument, similar to equities. To learn more about the filer API, click [here](https://developer.drivewealth.com/apis/reference/filterinstruments)

blocks.raw: For Mutual Funds, we have released broad support for the new instruments across our APIs. Mutual funds can now be viewed, generate quotes, and be traded using the same structure and approach as equities.
blocks.text: For Mutual Funds, we have released broad support for the new instruments across our APIs. Mutual funds can now be viewed, generate quotes, and be traded using the same structure and approach as equities.

blocks.raw: We also created additional readings about [Mutual Funds](https://developer.drivewealth.com/apis/v1.60.0/docs/mutual-funds) and [Fixed Income](https://developer.drivewealth.com/apis/v1.60.0/docs/fixed-income) feel free to review them as well.
